passages.title: Reading Passage: Life in the Countryside
passages.content: Life in the countryside has changed significantly over the past decades thanks to modern technology and rural development programs. In the past, farmers had to work hard manually from dawn till dusk without the help of modern machinery. Today, tractors and automated harvesting machines have made farm work much easier and more productive. Furthermore, high-speed Internet connectivity enables young villagers to access online educational resources, work remotely, and connect with friends across the country. Despite these advancements, rural areas continue to preserve their peaceful atmosphere, clean air, and close-knit community spirit. Neighbors always know one another and are willing to lend a helping hand during harvest seasons or festive celebrations.
passages.source: Adapted from English 8 Reading Comprehension Materials

sections.name: PART II. LANGUAGE FOCUS AND MATCHING
sections.title: Grammar, Fill-in-blank, Ordering and Sentence Matching

questions.content: What is the main topic of the passage?

choices.text: The changes and preserved values in modern countryside life
The disadvantages of using modern tractors in farming
Why young people in villages refuse to use the Internet
The environmental problems caused by urbanization

questions.step_by_step_solution: The passage outlines how rural life has changed positively with technology while maintaining its peaceful atmosphere and communal values.

questions.content: According to the passage, what has made farm work much easier and more productive?

choices.text: Working manually from dawn till dusk

questions.step_by_step_solution: Sentence 3 explicitly mentions: 'Today, tractors and automated harvesting machines have made farm work much easier and more productive.'

questions.content: Decide whether each of the following statements is True or False according to the passage:

sub_questions.content: In the past, farmers relied heavily on automated machinery for their daily farm work.
sub_questions.explanation: The text states farmers worked hard manually without modern machinery.

sub_questions.content: Internet access allows young villagers to study online and work remotely.
sub_questions.explanation: The text states high-speed Internet enables online educational resources and remote work.

sub_questions.content: Rural communities have completely lost their peaceful atmosphere due to technology.
sub_questions.explanation: The text says rural areas continue to preserve their peaceful atmosphere.

sub_questions.content: Neighbors in the countryside are willing to help each other during harvest seasons.
sub_questions.explanation: The text confirms neighbors lend a helping hand during harvest seasons.

questions.step_by_step_solution: Examine details in the reading passage to verify True or False for each statement.

questions.content: The word 'close-knit' in the passage is closest in meaning to:
questions.step_by_step_solution: 'Close-knit' describes a group or community where people have strong, supportive relationships.

questions.content: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the word in brackets: 'Living in a peaceful village is more ________ than living in a crowded metropolis.' [PEACE]
questions.step_by_step_solution: The comparative structure 'more ... than' requires the adjective 'peaceful'.

questions.content: Fill in the blank with the correct preposition: 'Farmers usually get up early ________ the morning to feed their cattle.'
questions.step_by_step_solution: The standard preposition used with 'the morning' is 'in'.

questions.content: Give the correct past continuous form of the verb 'plow' for the subject 'The farmers': 'At 9 a.m. yesterday, the farmers ________ (plow) their paddy fields.'
questions.step_by_step_solution: Past continuous with plural subject 'the farmers' is 'were plowing' (or British spelling 'were ploughing').

questions.content: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others:
questions.step_by_step_solution: 'Brave' is pronounced /eɪ/, whereas harvest, vast, and pasture have the /ɑː/ or /æ/ sound.

questions.content: Match each beginning in Column A with its appropriate ending in Column B to make meaningful sentences:

matchingPairs.left: Although the village is far from the city center,
matchingPairs.right: it has convenient bus routes and high-speed Internet.

matchingPairs.left: If you visit my hometown in the autumn,
matchingPairs.right: you can enjoy the sweet fragrance of ripe golden rice fields.
in order to preserve their agricultural products efficiently.

questions.step_by_step_solution: Pair 1 combines a concession clause (Although...) with contrast. Pair 2 is a Type 1 conditional. Pair 3 expresses purpose.

questions.content: Arrange the following clauses in the correct order to form a coherent compound sentence:
correctOrder: Modern technology has entered the countryside,
questions.step_by_step_solution: The logical sentence order is: 'Modern technology has entered the countryside, yet villagers still cherish their traditional values and hospitality.'
